INSERT INTO users
             (account_id, email, encrypted_password, role_id,
              confirmed_at, invite_id, approved,
              locale, created_by_application_id, sign_up_ip, age_verified_at,
              created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,
                   now(), $5, $6,
                   $7, $8, $9::text::inet, CASE WHEN $10 THEN now() END,
                   now(), now())
           RETURNING id
